notes.title: Patch notes for 3.7.5
notes.notes: Upgraded the game to use latest game engine version. This allows us to keep developing and supporting the game in the future.

notes.title: Game Update: New Graphics!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34325130/21c6064900c0acc54980ab710084f9d75aed3896.png[/img]

Red, Bomb, Chuck and The Blues are back - in a setting that is looking better than ever!

Patch notes:
- Full graphics remaster for all scenes
- Updated particle effects
- Improved haptics that scales depending on damage
- Fixed incorrect slingshot-to-hand offset
- Added new one handed play mode
- Menus open on menu button press
- Added full Chinese (zh-HANT and zh-HANS) support
- Achievement update to collecting all stars in game

notes.title: Game Update: Terror Peak is now live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34325130/fd9214d4e4adba31fbf9710fd183c92c090bf64a.png[/img]

It's time to defeat the dreaded Dr. Frankenswine once and for all. Terror Peak, the fourth world of the Spooky Levels is now live. We also included some bug fixes and made browsing easier in the level builder mode. 

Grab your virtual slingshot and join your feathered friends in the new world today!

notes.title: Game Update: Dr. Frankenswine returns with 13 new levels!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34325130/22c484966a3dd3a236cfadac46ff98821f3b3311.png[/img]

The horrifying Dr. Frankenswine is back with his minions. They're bringing along 13 new spooky levels set in Slimy Slopes. Pick up your slingshot and help Red, Chuck, Bomb and the Blues put a stop to Dr. Frankenswine's evil schemes!

Patch notes:
- A new level pack: Slimy Slopes is now available!
- Added hints on how to unlock spooky levels
- Added three more achievements
- Fixed an issue where the music sometimes stops playing in the spooky levels
- General bug fixes and polish

notes.title: Game Update: Level Builder Online Mode
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34325130/78c922bdb02a6fd55e269b7be32e04a4eb4fe30b.jpg[/img]

We have some really egg-citing news today! The level builder online mode is finally here and you can now play an endless amount of levels and share your best, funniest and most awesome levels with the world. 
[b]
Share and Discover[/b] – Upload your unique levels and have other players enjoy your creations. Try out other players' levels in the discovery menu, get the level code from a friend, or try out quick play for a random adventure.

What are you waiting for? It's time to get slingshotting!

notes.title: Game Update: Achievements
notes.notes:
Achievements are finally out! 17 achievements + 3 hidden ones can now be found on the Isle of Pigs.

If you have already completed the requirements prior to this update, you will automatically get the achievement.

Enjoy!

notes.title: The Uncanny Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34325130/fdc43d29064aebd2b065d5ec07015dc82826c0fd.png[/img]

The dastardly Dr. Frankenswine has taken over the Isle of Pigs, transforming it into his very own petrifying paradise! With his macabre machinery he’s whisked away the eggs again, leaving a whole new set of levels in his wake. Explore Maliboo Beach, Creepy Climb, Slimey Slopes and make your way to Terror Peak, battling with the scarily cute scientist as you go! 

[b]Horrifying extras include:[/b]

A brand [b]new block[/b]! Introducing the [b]Alchemy Bomb[/b], a tricksy cube that transforms other blocks when it explodes!
[b]13 new levels[/b], each more alarmingly challenging than the last!
A brand new Big Pig, [b]Dr Frankenswine[/b] himself!
An [b]army of Piglings [/b]ready to do his bidding…
A ghoulishly groovy [b]new soundtrack[/b]!
And much, much more! 

And remember! On the Isle of Pigs, no one can hear you squeal… 

[url=https://youtu.be/MEZVEF7M1nw]Click here to watch the trailer![/url]

notes.title: Angry Birds VR: Isle of Pigs 2.6.43034 patch note
notes.notes: Thanks for the feedback! You asked about left-hand support as well as an option to remove the slingshot aim and we listened. Beginning today, if you go to the settings menu, you can switch hand controls and turn off the slingshot aim to make the game more difficult. We’re also working on new levels, content and additional updates and will have more updates soon.
